notes.title: v2 Update: New Characters, UI & Visual Improvements
notes.content:
The long-awaited major update for Police Car Simulator is live! With this v2 update, many new features have been added to the game, existing systems have been improved, and the player experience has been taken to the next level.

Here are the innovations that come with the update
[list]
[*] Police Station added: Now there is a center you can visit before and after the mission.
[*] In-car character added: Your character now appears animated while inside the vehicle. This increases the level of realism and makes the driving experience more impressive.
[*] Interface improved: Menu transitions, mission panels, and information boxes have been made more readable and stylish.
[*] Graphics quality optimized: The graphics have been reworked for a smoother gaming experience, especially on low and medium-level devices. Visual quality is now both better and more efficient.
[*] How to Play screen added: A guide screen is now available in the game for new players. Controls and basic gameplay mechanics can be easily learned.
[*] Camera and mouse controls bugs fixed: In-car and out-of-car camera transitions, mouse sensitivity, and viewing direction bugs have been fixed. A smoother and more error-free control experience is now offered.
[/list]
